title: India's Biggest Stock Exchange Just Listed: What NSE's Debut on BSE Means
description: The National Stock Exchange (NSE), India's largest stock exchange, listed its shares on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on September 24, 2026. This was a majo.

faq.q: What is the IPO price of NSE?
faq.a: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) price for NSE shares was ₹1,785 per share.

faq.q: When did NSE list on BSE?
faq.a: NSE shares listed and began trading on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on September 24, 2026.

faq.q: What was NSE's market capitalization after listing?
faq.a: On its debut, NSE had a market capitalization of ₹4.5 lakh crore, making it one of the most valued companies in India.

faq.q: Why can't NSE list on its own exchange?
faq.a: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has regulations that prevent a stock exchange from listing its own shares on its platform to avoid potential conflicts of interest and ensure fair market practices.

faq.q: Who sold shares in the NSE IPO?
faq.a: The IPO was an Offer for Sale (OFS), meaning existing shareholders of NSE sold their shares to the public.
